premise: When Maya discovers her fiancé secretly sold her family's bakery during their engagement party, a mysterious stranger steps in to defend her. She must navigate betrayal and unmask her silent ally to save her family legacy.

characters.name: Maya
characters.who: Bakery owner betrayed by her fiancé

characters.name: Daniel
characters.who: Maya's deceitful fiancé who secretly sold the bakery

characters.name: The Stranger
characters.who: Mysterious ally who secretly owns the bakery building

reveals.reveal: The quiet stranger is revealed to be the true owner of the bakery building.
